operationUnit: complete reverse-search iteration including needle and position selection and retaining byte index + 1; setup runs once per workload invocation
specification: Find the greatest ascii substring match start at or before the default byte length. Retain every byte index as index + 1, including misses. Empty needles return the selected position; overlapping matches remain visible.
notes: Needle pool setup, reverse search, selection and complete result retention are timed. ASCII byte offsets equal UTF16 offsets, so the TypeScript counterpart directly calls actual String.lastIndexOf with the same position pool and no coordinate bridge. Complete observation runs outside timing. These are complete iterations, not isolated-call latency or allocation-parity measurements.
